1 Bedroom
2 Bathrooms
801 sq ft Built-Up Area
Open-plan living and dining area
Modern fitted kitchen
Built-in wardrobes
Floor-to-ceiling windows
High-quality contemporary finishes

Private beach access
Infinity swimming pool
Fully equipped fitness centre
Landscaped podium and outdoor leisure areas
Children's play area
Covered parking
24-hour security
Concierge service
Waterfront retail and dining

Prime location in La Mer, Jumeirah
Walking distance to beachfront cafés and restaurants
Minutes from City Walk and Downtown Dubai
Easy access to DIFC and Dubai International Airport
Close to luxury hotels, retail, and entertainment
Excellent connectivity via Jumeirah Road and Sheikh Zayed Road
